title: Type Conversion - Float to Int
concept: Use `as Int` to convert a Float64 to an Int — but beware, it truncates the decimal part!
why: Sometimes you need a whole number from a decimal — like getting the integer part of a price or measurement.
syntax_ref: value as Int  →  converts Float64 to Int (truncates decimal)
tips: `as Int` truncates — it does NOT round!
Use `math.round(value)` if you need proper rounding
Converting Float64 to Int loses the decimal part forever
Only convert when you genuinely need a whole number
common_mistakes: Expecting `3.99 as Int` to give `4` — it gives `3` (truncation)
Converting to Int when you should be using Float64 for precision
Losing important decimal information by converting too early
